study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Fang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities uncover two robust transdiagnostic biotypes

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states the research objective to identify transdiagnostic subtypes based on individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities and investigate their biological underpinnings.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we aimed to identify distinct transdiagnostic subtypes based on individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities compared to normal expectations.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The eligibility criteria for the reference cohorts (healthy controls) are described for the Discovery (CNP) and Validation datasets. Image quality standards (exclusion based on signal dropouts/artifacts) and final sample sizes are reported.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The CNP dataset... includes... healthy controls (HCs, n = 130). ... Inclusion criteria for all participants mandated a minimum of eight years of formal education... HCs had no lifetime diagnoses... Participants with missing behavioral scores/images or signal dropouts in the cerebellum were excluded

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and sex were used as covariates in the normative model. Multi-site effects were managed by using single-site datasets (e.g., Validation 2 used site 20) or analyzing datasets independently.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) based on age and sex in HCs.

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data sources for the reference cohorts are clearly specified (UCLA CNP, COBRE, DIRECT Site 20, SALD).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The discovery dataset was obtained from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP)... The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)... The validation dataset 2 was obtained from site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT)... another extensive dataset... (SALD)...

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Detailed image acquisition parameters (TR, TE, FOV, Matrix, etc.) are provided for all datasets in the Supplementary Methods.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: Discovery dataset... T1-weighted anatomical images were acquired using the following parameters: TR = 1.9 s, TE = 2.26 ms, FOV = 250 mm...

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing procedures using the CAT12 toolbox and standard pipeline are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: The T1-weighted anatomical images underwent preprocessing using the CAT12 toolbox... to derive voxel-level gray matter voxel-based morphometry... obtained gray matter maps underwent smoothing using a 6-mm full width at half maximum Gaussian kernel.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study states that the model was trained on HCs and applied to patients, but does not describe using a data partitioning strategy (like cross-validation or hold-out) to validate the normative model itself on the reference cohort.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) based on age and sex in HCs. This trained model was then applied to each patient...

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: While the study uses external datasets (COBRE, DIRECT) to replicate the *subtyping* results, it does not explicitly state that the normative model trained on the discovery cohort (CNP) was validated on the external healthy controls to assess model generalization. It appears local normative models may have been used or the validation focus was on the clinical findings rather than the model fit.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: In the validation dataset 1... individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities also revealed two distinct subtypes... inferred by the cluster centroids obtained from the subtypes identified in the discovery dataset

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The type of statistical model (Gaussian process regression) is specified, but key model settings (e.g., kernel type, priors) and the specific software used for the modeling (e.g., PCNtoolkit) are not described in the text.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) based on age and sex in HCs.

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: No quantitative metrics assessing the fit or calibration of the normative model (e.g., explained variance, MAE) in the reference cohort are reported.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: This trained model was then applied to each patient, generating predicted GMVs. Subsequently, Z scores... were calculated

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: Data partitioning for internal validation of the normative model was not performed.

nm11_reproducibility.reason: Software versions for the normative modeling analysis and code availability are not specified.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: Data availability... Supplementary data... (No mention of code availability in Acknowledgements or Methods)

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: Diagnostic criteria (DSM-IV) and exclusion criteria for the clinical cohorts are described. Sample sizes are reported.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: Diagnoses were based on the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV-Text Revision... Exclusion criteria for all participants mandated... absence of significant medical illness, and negative urinalysis results...

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: The study explicitly mentions that clinical covariates such as medication dosage were not examined due to lack of sufficient information. Comparison of subtypes controlled for age, sex, and TIV, but not clinical variables.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: due to a lack of sufficient clinical information such as education level, alcohol and especially for medication dosage, we were unable to examine their effects on the clustering outcomes.

cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.reason: Data sources for the clinical cohorts are clearly specified (UCLA CNP, COBRE, DIRECT).
cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: The discovery dataset was obtained from... (CNP)... validation dataset 1... (COBRE)... validation dataset 2... (DIRECT)...

cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.reason: Sample sizes, demographics (age, sex, education), and some clinical characteristics (diagnosis, substance use) are reported in Table S1.
cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.supporting_text: The clinical and demographic information of datasets used in this study was included in Table S1.

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.reason: Clinical assessment measures like SCID for DSM-IV and HAMD are specified.
cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: Diagnoses were based on the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV-Text Revision... symptom severity was assessed using the Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HAMD)

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: The interpretation of deviation scores (positive Z = higher GMV) is provided. These scores are used to identify subtypes, and the clinical/biological implications (biotypes) are discussed.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: Positive Z scores indicated higher GMVs in patients compared to HCs, and vice versa. ... identify transdiagnostic subtypes...
